[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Copy chips: click-to-copy text authored in Obsidian notes[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Typing an inline code span that starts with `copy:` (or a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob-copy` fence) gives a quiet, theme-native chip that copies [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exactly the authored text with one click or one key, in every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Obsidian view. Mod+Shift+Y makes or edits a chip without [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]hand-escaping. The GTD agent prompts in gtd_daily.md are the first [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]chips.[/#D7D7AF]
